services.desc: The GULF STREAM comes closer to land off the shores of Palm Beach more than anywhere else in the United States. At times, the Gulf Stream can be less than a mile from the beach. Its crystal clear waters make it unmistakable. During the. winter months, thousands of sailfish migrate down the edge of the Gulf Stream bringing them only a mile off the edge of the Palm Beach coast. It’s not uncommon to have multiple hook ups at one time. This is strictly catch and release. And what an adrenalin rush! We also catch many wahoo, kingfish, blackfin tuna, amberjack.
